description: This PHP script handles the saving and updating of Mail Scanner configuration in the vtiger CRM system, including validation, connection testing, and updating folder scan settings.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Class representing mail scanner configuration details.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailBox
classes.description: Class for handling mailbox connection and folder operations.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares current scanner info with new info to determine if changes occurred.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns the scanner info as an associative array.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the scanner info in the database.

methods.name: updateAllFolderRescan
methods.description: Sets the rescan flag for all folders.

methods.name: updateLastscan
methods.description: Updates the last scan timestamp for a folder.
